source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of stack operations (PDF 96-97).

items: Push: top par cheez jorna. Python mein list ko stack banaya jata hai aur append() push karta hai.
Pop: list ke pop() se top wali cheez hatana.

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
stack_of_books = []
stack_of_books.append("Book A")
stack_of_books.append("Book B")
stack_of_books.append("Book C")
print("Stack:", stack_of_books)        # Book A, Book B, Book C
top_book = stack_of_books.pop()
print("Removed book:", top_book)       # Book C
print("Stack now:", stack_of_books)    # Book A, Book B

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: list ki paanch cheezein Decorations, Snacks, Cold drinks, Plates, Balloons index 0 se 4 ke saath aur list ke amal ke notes. Oopar daen: Book A, Book B aur Book C ka stack, push oopar jorta aur pop Book C hatata hai. Neeche baen: queue Ahmed, Fatima, Ali, Sara, aage se dequeue aur peeche enqueue. Neeche daen: 3 4 5 * + nikalte waqt stack ki halatein [3], [3, 4], [3, 4, 5], [3, 20], [23].
blocks.caption: Lists, stacks, queues aur postfix evaluation (topics 4.1.1 se 4.1.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: List cheezon ko 0 se shuru hone wale index ke saath tarteeb mein rakhti hai, to Plates index 3 par hai, aur cheezein dakhil, aakhir mein jori, hatayi ya dhoondi ja sakti hain. Kitabon ka stack sirf oopar se istemal hota hai: push Book B aur Book A ke oopar Book C rakhta, aur pop pehle Book C hatata hai, jo aakhir mein aayi thi. Queue aage se khidmat karti aur peeche jorti hai: Ahmed, jo pehle aaya, pehle farigh hota hai, aur Sara Ali ke peeche lagti hai. 3 4 5 * + nikalne ke liye adad baari baari push hote hain; * 5 aur 4 nikal kar 20 push karta, phir + 20 aur 3 nikal kar jawab 23 push karta hai.

blocks.text: Mez par kitabon ke dher ki tarah, aap sirf oopar kitab rakh sakte ya oopar wali utha sakte hain. Stacks depth-first search (DFS) mein bhi khangalne wale nodes ko LIFO tarteeb mein sambhalne ke liye istemal hote hain (Did You Know).
